strengths: Typed decisions only: answers choice, yes/no and scale questions about one state, with probabilities, in a few hundred milliseconds and for a fraction of a cent. Generates no text and calls no tools.

note: A local row: the model as an OpenAI-compatible vLLM server serves it on the operator's own hardware, read on 2026-10-07 from the server's own GET /v1/models. context_window 150000 = the max_model_len that answer reports. Local inference bills nothing, so every price is 0 and there is no input_cache_read price to read. Window rates (GH #1085): chars_per_token 3: the cell's cautious default, stated; a local server refuses a prompt past its window, so the estimate stays high. Not measured.
strengths: A model served on the operator's own hardware behind an OpenAI-compatible server: no per-token price and no data leaving the machine, with a window far smaller than the hosted rows. Reached by name only.
